messages:
Priya: Hey folks — proposing a 2-week "quickstart sprint" to onboard LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters into our gateway marketplace flow. Goal: deliver a docs + reference adapter + marketplace listing + SI demo by end of sprint. Who's in?
Evan: +1. Important we sync with the cloud marketplace team for listing requirements. I'll loop them in. :white_check_mark:
Marcos: From runtime side we need a small compatibility checklist: model variants supported, tokenization edgecases, streaming vs non-streaming endpoints. I can draft.
Jin: I can own the quickstart README and the sample app (React + Redwood SDK). Will add a prebuilt Docker for local testing.
Tara: Solutions + SI here — we should define a short demo script focused on a POC for an enterprise customer (SSO, data plane isolation). I'll sketch the flow.
Priya: Nice. I'll map out success metrics: "first-time-run" in <15min, sample query latency under 300ms for tokenized prompt (small test), marketplace publish checklist done.
MarketplaceBot: Action created: MARKETPLACE-312 "ISV Quickstart - LangChain / LlamaIndex" assigned to Evan. Due 2026-04-10.
Evan: Re: cloud marketplace: need SKU metadata, icon, marketing blurb, and legal contact. Marcos do you need any runtime metadata fields?
Marcos: Yes — GPU requirements (if demo uses quantized weights), recommended batch sizes, supported sequence lengths, and a compatibility tag (e.g., "continuous-kv-cache-ready").
Anika: From partnerships ops — let's also coordinate a joint announcement window with the HW partner (NimbleAccel). They have a booth at EdgeConf the week after sprint ends. If we time it, big win.
Jin: quick tech note — for LangChain agents we should include an adapter that exposes function/tool calling via our gateway. Sample code snippet in the repo: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="redwood/small-quant", prompt="...", stream=True)
```
Tara: Demo script idea: 1) Onboard customer -> SSO, 2) Deploy quickstart adapter -> run sample orchestration with LangChain, 3) Show failover to hosted fallback when dedicated capacity saturated. Short and punchy.
Priya: Risk log: 1) Marketplace review SLA could be 5-7 business days, 2) HW partner needs legal signoff on logo usage, 3) adapter must pass our security review (secrets handling). We'll add these as blockers in the ticket.
Evan: I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow with cloud marketplace + NimbleAccel + eng leads. Sending invite now.
MarketplaceBot: Calendar invite sent: "ISV Quickstart Sprint Kickoff" Thu 09:30 PT.
Marcos: Quick spike: I'll run a perf baseline on the quantized LlamaIndex pipeline and post results to the repo by EOD tomorrow.
Anika: I'll coordinate PR approvals for co-marketing and confirm the embargo window with NimbleAccel — prefer not to go public until integrated demo is stable.
Priya: Great. Owners: Evan (marketplace/legal), Marcos (runtime perf/checklist), Jin (devex + sample app), Tara (demo + SI playbook), Anika (partner ops). I'll keep the sprint board updated.
Tara: One small ask — can we get a sample dataset we can use in the demo that doesn't have PII? Maybe the partners can provide anonymized logs.
Anika: I'll request sanitized dataset from NimbleAccel.
Jin: Putting initial repo skeleton here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/isv-quickstart-template/pull/1 — feedback welcome.
Priya: Awesome, thanks everyone. We'll use the sprint template in the board and do daily stand at 10:15 PT. :rocket:
